text: The purpose of this report is to advise of the results of Request for Proposal (RFP) Document Number 3002340572 for the provision of short-term accommodations for shelter clients through the use of hotel, motel and/or approved equivalent operator services for operating shelters and to request authority for the General Manager of Shelter, Support and Housing Administration to enter into and execute separate contracts with New Lido Inc. and Silver Hotel Management Inc. for a period of one (1) year from the date of award with the option to renew contracts for four (4) separate additional one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the General Manager of Shelter, Support and Housing Administration will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
